# RUA Thai Spa

Authentic traditional Thai massage and wellness sanctuary. Codified Siamese therapeutic practices directly stemming from the ancient medical manuscripts of Wat Pho temple in Bangkok.

## Contact & Location
* **Address**: Shop No. B216, 2nd Floor, City Centre 2, Kolkata - 700157
* **Phone**: +91 74499 62261
* **Email**: bookings@ruathaispa.com
* **Hours**: Monday - Sunday, 10:00 AM - 09:00 PM

## Signature Massages (Summary)
* **Swedish Massage**: Gentle full-body stroke massage for first-timers and relaxation. (From 3,000 INR)
* **Deep Tissue Massage**: Firm pressure technique targeting chronic muscle tension and stiffness. (From 3,600 INR)
* **Aromatherapy Massage**: Healing massage combined with pure Siamese essential oils. (From 3,000 INR)
* **Balinese Massage**: Acupressure, skin-rolling, and stretching from Balinese traditions. (From 3,500 INR)

For full details, including comprehensive treatment lists, pricing tiers, benefits, guidelines, and FAQs, see [Full LLMs Context](https://ruathaispa.com/llms-full.txt).
